title: CMB anomaly row
description: One canonical CMB large-scale structural anomaly. Single row_type catalogue ('anomaly_feature'); each row records the anomaly's canonical name, anomaly_kind classification, multipole range, statistical significance, sky location (where applicable), discovery + key confirmation references.

anomaly_id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier (e.g., 'axis-of-evil-l2-l3-alignment'). Used in cite_as / purpose templates.

canonical_name.description: Human-readable name as used in the literature (e.g., 'Axis of Evil', 'Cold Spot', 'Hemispherical Power Asymmetry').

anomaly_kind.description: Structural classification: 'alignment' = multipole vectors aligned with each other / external direction; 'hotspot' = localized region of extreme temperature; 'asymmetry' = power difference between hemispheres or directions; 'suppression' = deficit relative to ΛCDM prediction; 'parity_violation' = excess odd-vs-even multipole power; 'correlation_anomaly' = deviation in two-point or higher-point correlation; 'other' = anything not fitting the above.

ell_range_min.description: Minimum multipole over which the anomaly is defined.

ell_range_max.description: Maximum multipole over which the anomaly is defined.

statistical_significance_sigma.description: Reported statistical significance in equivalent Gaussian σ, where applicable. Many CMB anomaly significances are test-dependent and analysis-dependent; this field reports a representative value from the cited principal reference. Null if not quantified by a single number (e.g., 'observed' but uncertain whether anomalous).

statistical_test.description: Brief description of the statistical test used to compute the significance (e.g., 'Angle between l=2 and l=3 multipole vectors, vs. simulated ΛCDM ensemble', or 'S 1/2 statistic, vs. simulations').

sky_location_galactic_lon_deg.description: Galactic longitude in degrees of the anomaly's central direction, where applicable (Cold Spot, hemispherical asymmetry preferred direction, alignment axis). Null if the anomaly does not have a localized direction (e.g., low quadrupole, parity asymmetry).

sky_location_galactic_lat_deg.description: Galactic latitude in degrees of the anomaly's central direction, where applicable.

principal_reference_doi.description: DOI of the canonical discovery paper for this anomaly. 'nodoi:' prefix accepted for pre-DOI references (rare for CMB literature).

principal_reference_label.description: Human-readable label of the principal reference (e.g., 'de Oliveira-Costa et al. 2004 PRD 69:063516').

confirmation_reference_dois.description: DOIs of key confirmation / follow-up references. Includes the Planck 2018 VII re-validation (10.1051/0004-6361/201833881) for anomalies confirmed in PR3.

precision_flag.description: Per-§17.1.6 ship-readiness convention. 'test_dependent' flags anomalies whose significance varies meaningfully across statistical tests (most CMB anomalies fall here).

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — typical interpretive caveats, alternative analyses, or links to related anomalies.

source_doi.description: DOI of the primary citation for this row's facts. Default 10.1051/0004-6361/201833881 (Planck 2018 VII) for anomalies confirmed in PR3.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional Planck release version (e.g., 'PR3') for the confirmation re-validation.
